text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I lost the Hanshin JF... I couldn't show 
Trainer what it looks like when I win.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But, when I ran my hardest, people in the 
crowd praised me...! It felt like I was 
able to give my Trainer confidence too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Looking at your face made me think. Could 
it be that meeting right "now"... was 
really important?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... I want to give 
Trainer a victory in a big race this time! 
I'll take on the Tiara route—the Oka Sho!
